title: How is Kim Jong Un connected to Mickey Mouse?
description:
Three real photos connect North Korea's Kim Jong Un to Mickey Mouse, through two American presidents.

Kim Jong Un → Donald Trump → Ronald Reagan → Mickey Mouse

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
